fact: On 15 May 2024 PAIX Data Centres announced a joint venture with the Djibouti Sovereign Fund in which PAIX will purchase the land, buildings and equipment for a data centre in Djibouti; no amount is named.
title: PAIX Data Centres Announces Joint Venture with Djibouti Sovereign Fund to Construct a Cloud- And Carrier-Neutral Data Centre in Djibouti
